rationale: Independent of the producer, I re-hashed every cited held text and checked each span against the bytes (EO_11460.txt 3afba71a..., EO_11984.txt e1f352b1...; producer file byte sha256 4c4262aa..., canonical f98a025f...). Identity: EO 11460, 34 FR 5535-36, March 20, 1969, establishing the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board, which matches the API metadata and the 1989 row. I read the whole original. Secs. 1-5 set up a continuing board (functions, information access, appointments, staff, funding), and sec. 6 revokes EO 10938; there is no term, sunset or savings clause. EO 11984 (May 4, 1977; 42 FR 23129, FR of May 6, 1977) states that, 'in order to abolish the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board, Executive Order No. 11460 of March 20, 1969, is hereby revoked'. There is no exception, delayed effective wording or savings, so this is a presidential whole-order revocation and supports a provisional NO. Contrary/earlier: EO 11905 sec. 6(f) merely affirmed the Board 'remains in effect'; EO 11985 sec. 6 deleted that subsection and the cross-membership sentence, which neither ends nor extends 11460. The cruden number search found 6 matches in 5 files with no post-1977 revival. No history flags exist, and both observations are corroboration only. Lifecycle gaps remain: no effective date of the revocation is established (signing is not an effective date), there is no complete later-source search, page images were not inspected, and the consequences of performed acts (the 10938 revocation, board appointments, residual records) are not decided. This review is a nonauthoritative independent check only and does not adopt a status.
